title: AI TV Show Generator: Turn an Idea Into a Show
summary: Use Flick's AI TV show generator to turn an idea into a show: build the world, cast and voices, then shoot each scene, as a residency fantasy show did.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI TV show generator?


An AI TV show generator is a tool that turns a premise into the pieces of a show: characters, places, voices and generated scenes. Flick's does it on one canvas, so each new shot can cite the cast and places made before it.


### Can AI make a whole TV show?


AI can generate each shot of a show, but the decisions are still yours: the story, the cast, the order of scenes and which take to keep. In 'twixt Vows, a 16:00[residency](https://flick.art/residency) show made in Flick, was cut from 373 generated video clips.


### How do I keep characters consistent from episode to episode?


Make one turnaround sheet and one recorded voice line for each character, and cite both in each shot they appear in. Keep them in the same project, so a later episode reuses the same references.


### Is Flick's AI TV show generator free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The free plan has AI chat, image models, Text to Voice and MiniMax H3 Max video; Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### Which video models can I use to make a TV show in Flick?


Flick runs Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0, Kling 3.0 Pro, Veo 3.1 and MiniMax H3 on the Standard plan, and MiniMax H3 Max on the free plan. You can mix models across scenes on the same canvas.


### How do AI characters speak dialogue in a show?


Write the line in quotes in the shot prompt and generate with a video model that makes audio. For a steady voice, record the line with Text to Voice first and cite that recording as the voice to match.


### Can I import a script I already wrote?


Yes. Every project you own has a screenplay editor. Import Fountain, Final Draft (.fdx), PDF or Word, and export PDF or Word.


### Who owns the show I make with AI in Flick?


You do. Content you generate on Flick is yours for personal and commercial projects. See the terms of use for detail.
